text: Harness: reflection stage that writes reflections on parent connections after an idea settles
description: When verify settles an idea (implemented/failed/cancelled), the reflector role gets each parent edge's hypothesis plus the outcome and evidence, and returns one reflection per edge ('held / did not hold / unclear, because...'). Harness writes them via the connection's reflection field. Also: when all children of a parent settle, prompt a reflection one level up. Keeps the experience graph growing as a side effect of normal work.

status.comment: Per-edge reflection after a verified verdict is in the reflect stage (cycle.ts; harness writes 'Held: …' / 'Did not hold: …' / 'Unclear: …' on real parent edges only). 'One level up' needs no extra stage: when the last child of a parent settles, the parent has no ongoing child, so it is an open leaf (workStageFor/isOpenLeaf, tested in stages.test 'settled children do not make a container'); the next orient executes it with its children's outcomes and bets in the compiled context (context.ts children section), the verifier checks it, and the reflect stage then writes reflections on the parent's own parent edges. Evidence: stages.test, cycle.test (reflection written, non-parents dropped), context.test (children outcomes in context); loop-worker 27/27.
